queries.title: How SLEEPER, welfare, trespass, 5150 and 647F calls ended, by year
queries.method: Calls in Calls fixture, cfs_2026, Calls fixture, cfs_2025, one row per incident number (the latest entry when the publisher repeats one; where the latest entries share a time but not a disposition, the incident is counted as conflicting and under no outcome), whose call type is exactly SLEEPER, CW, 602, 5150, 647F, counted per calendar year of date_time by disposition code. A code beginning A is an arrest, R a report, K no report required; U is unfounded; X, W, CAN, DUP, V are calls cancelled before a unit was sent or on scene, or duplicate calls, and are counted apart. A code ending HR is a call the Crisis Response Team was involved in and is also counted under its first letter. A blank disposition is counted apart, not as K. Other codes are listed with their description from Calls fixture, cfs_dispositions. Where a year's file was retrieved more than once, only the latest copy is read.
queries.sql:
WITH call_rows AS (
 SELECT TRIM(CAST("incident_num" AS VARCHAR)) AS incident, UPPER(TRIM(CAST("call_type" AS VARCHAR))) AS call_type, NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(CAST("disposition" AS VARCHAR))), '') AS dispo,
  TRY_CAST(CAST("date_time" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS called_at
 FROM "analysis_cfs_2026"
 UNION ALL
 SELECT TRIM(CAST("incident_num" AS VARCHAR)) AS incident, UPPER(TRIM(CAST("call_type" AS VARCHAR))) AS call_type, NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(CAST("disposition" AS VARCHAR))), '') AS dispo,
  TRY_CAST(CAST("date_time" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS called_at
 FROM "analysis_cfs_2025"
), incidents AS (
 SELECT *, incident IS NOT NULL AND MIN(COALESCE(dispo, '')) OVER (PARTITION BY incident, called_at) <> MAX(COALESCE(dispo, '')) OVER (PARTITION BY incident, called_at) AS conflicted
 FROM call_rows
 QUALIFY incident IS NULL OR ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY incident ORDER BY called_at DESC NULLS LAST, dispo NULLS LAST) = 1
), typed AS (
 SELECT YEAR(called_at) AS call_year, call_type, dispo, called_at, CASE WHEN conflicted THEN 'conflicting' WHEN dispo IS NULL THEN 'blank' WHEN dispo IN ('X', 'W', 'CAN', 'DUP', 'V') THEN 'cancelled_duplicate' WHEN STARTS_WITH(dispo, 'A') THEN 'arrest'
  WHEN STARTS_WITH(dispo, 'R') THEN 'report' WHEN STARTS_WITH(dispo, 'K') THEN 'no_report' WHEN dispo = 'U' THEN 'unfounded' ELSE 'other' END AS outcome FROM incidents WHERE call_type IN ('SLEEPER', 'CW', '602', '5150', '647F')
), codes AS (
 SELECT UPPER(TRIM(CAST("dispo_code" AS VARCHAR))) AS code, MIN(TRIM(CAST("description" AS VARCHAR))) AS description FROM "analysis_cfs_dispositions" GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT call_year, call_type, COUNT(*) AS calls, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'cancelled_duplicate') AS cancelled_duplicate, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'blank') AS blank, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'conflicting') AS conflicting,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'arrest') AS arrest, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'report') AS report, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'no_report') AS no_report,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'unfounded') AS unfounded, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'other') AS other, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome <> 'conflicting' AND ENDS_WITH(dispo, 'HR')) AS crisis_team,
 STRING_AGG(DISTINCT dispo || COALESCE(' (' || codes.description || ')', ''), '; ') FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'other') AS other_codes, CAST(MAX(called_at) AS VARCHAR) AS last_call
FROM typed LEFT JOIN codes ON codes.code = typed.dispo
GROUP BY call_year, call_type ORDER BY call_year DESC NULLS LAST, call_type

queries.title: Where SLEEPER calls were sent, by police beat
queries.method: SLEEPER calls in Calls fixture, cfs_2026, Calls fixture, cfs_2025, one row per incident number as above, leaving out the cancelled and duplicate codes X, W, CAN, DUP, V unless the incident's latest entries disagree on the disposition, counted by the beat of the call's address with the neighborhood from Calls fixture, cfs_beats. The ten beats with most calls are read, with the citywide total and the calls with no beat recorded.
queries.sql:
WITH call_rows AS (
 SELECT TRIM(CAST("incident_num" AS VARCHAR)) AS incident, UPPER(TRIM(CAST("call_type" AS VARCHAR))) AS call_type, NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(CAST("disposition" AS VARCHAR))), '') AS dispo,
  TRY_CAST(CAST("date_time" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS called_at, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("beat" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS beat
 FROM "analysis_cfs_2026"
 UNION ALL
 SELECT TRIM(CAST("incident_num" AS VARCHAR)) AS incident, UPPER(TRIM(CAST("call_type" AS VARCHAR))) AS call_type, NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(CAST("disposition" AS VARCHAR))), '') AS dispo,
  TRY_CAST(CAST("date_time" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS called_at, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("beat" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS beat
 FROM "analysis_cfs_2025"
), incidents AS (
 SELECT *, incident IS NOT NULL AND MIN(COALESCE(dispo, '')) OVER (PARTITION BY incident, called_at) <> MAX(COALESCE(dispo, '')) OVER (PARTITION BY incident, called_at) AS conflicted
 FROM call_rows
 QUALIFY incident IS NULL OR ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY incident ORDER BY called_at DESC NULLS LAST, dispo NULLS LAST) = 1
), sleeper AS (
 SELECT beat, called_at FROM incidents WHERE call_type = 'SLEEPER' AND (conflicted OR dispo IS NULL OR dispo NOT IN ('X', 'W', 'CAN', 'DUP', 'V'))
), places AS (
 SELECT TRIM(CAST("beat" AS VARCHAR)) AS beat, MIN(TRIM(CAST("neighborhood" AS VARCHAR))) AS neighborhood FROM "analysis_cfs_beats" GROUP BY 1
)
, beat_calls AS (
 SELECT beat, COUNT(*) AS calls FROM sleeper WHERE beat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY beat
), sleeper_totals AS (
 SELECT COUNT(*) AS citywide_calls, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE beat IS NULL) AS no_beat, MIN(YEAR(called_at)) AS first_year, MAX(YEAR(called_at)) AS last_year FROM sleeper
)
SELECT beat_calls.beat, places.neighborhood AS neighborhood, beat_calls.calls, citywide_calls, no_beat, first_year, last_year
FROM beat_calls CROSS JOIN sleeper_totals LEFT JOIN places ON places.beat = beat_calls.beat
ORDER BY beat_calls.calls DESC, beat_calls.beat LIMIT 10
